spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** Know that before states of spiritual obscurity and states of illumination were yet distinguished within the whole of the mind, a third proceeding divine truth was called forth from the Divine. And afterwards it was directed into the desolate states devoid of good and truth — the external mind in its emptiness and waste — so that it might refine the wisdom held captive there, and separate obscurity from illumination, falsity from truth, each from the other.

**¶3:** Before wisdom was liberated and released from bondage and could ascend through the successive degrees of the mind, Divine Love prepared for it doctrinal forms of radiant order. He fashioned these containing vessels so that wisdom might be purified within them, and be shaped and arranged into genuine spiritual order.

**¶4:** Before evil from falsity had proliferated and established its dominion in the proprium of the natural man, before those who are justified and those who are condemned were yet distinguished from one another, Divine Truth in its judicial function was sent forth and made manifest. The seat of its judgment was established and set in the living spiritual sphere, so that it would judge impartially, so that there those in good and those in evil would be set apart and examined and separated from each other.

**¶6:** Again, before the spiritual church had been brought into being, some were designated [GAP-1: as abundant in knowledges of truth, and] others as lacking them upon the natural plane [GAP-2: according to what was foreseen and provided] concerning them. Before they undergo vastation, those who will undergo spiritual death are determined by their knowledges of good and truth and by the ordering of spiritual states in the heavenly arrangement. These states are appointed for them; within them lie their spiritual origins. And their inmost life is bound up with their governing spiritual states; and they are led by those states and brought to an impartial judgment in accordance with their works and their evils.

**¶7:** Again, before the whole spiritual state is brought to its end, [GAP-3: and the] entire external church with it, the vastating truths were ordained and prepared for its dissolution.

**¶8:** And before the new state of the church was [GAP-4: established and] perfected and fully delineated, [GAP-5: the] divine formative power was called forth — the first ordering principle of truth and the proceeding divine truths that act with it — who would establish and bring to perfection the new spiritual age.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Know that before night and day were differentiated in the universe, the Third [Am]bassador was summoned. And afterwards, he was sent to this void and outer waste that he might purify the light, and separate night and day from each other.

Before the light was released and freed and ascended through this zone, the Father of Life made beautiful for it the ships of light. He constructed them so that it might be purified in them, and be sculpted and fashioned in good order.

[Bef]ore Sin had multiplied and had made a kingdom in the flesh, before the acquitted and the condemn[ed] were set apart from each other, the Judge [w]as sent forth and revealed. His throne was created and placed [i]n the living atmosphere, so that he would be a just Judge, so that there the righteous and the sinners would be set apart and tested and separated from each other.

Again, [befo]re mankind had been engendered, some were named ['rich' and] others 'poor' on earth [as was appointed] upon them. Before they die, they who will die are marked out by the stars and the signs of the zodiac in the sphere. They are appointed for them; in them are their births. And their root is bound up with their zodiacal signs; and they are compelled by them and brought to an equal judgement in accordance with their deeds and their sins.
Again, before the universe is dissolved, [and the] entire earth, the destroyers were appointed and instructed for its dissolution.

And before the ne[w] aeon was [built and] made be[auti]ful and marked out, [the] Great Builder [w]as summoned, the first architect and the angels who are with him, who would build and make beautiful the new aeon.

fills.explanation: The editor's "'rich' and" is confirmed: "rich" is the natural-plane correspondent of "abundant in knowledges of truth" (per Swedenborg's correspondence of riches = knowledges), and pairs directly with "poor" later in the sentence.

The spiritual reading indicates "according to what was foreseen and provided," which in the Kephalaia's natural register translates to "as was appointed," a term already used in this paragraph ("They are appointed for them"), completing the phrase "on earth as was appointed upon them."

The editor's "and the" is confirmed: the spiritual reading shows "and the entire external church with it," requiring the conjunction and article to link "the universe" with "the entire earth" as two aspects of the same dissolution.

The editor's "built and" is confirmed: "built" is the natural-plane expression for "established" in the spiritual reading, and it coheres with the Great Builder who "would build and make beautiful the new aeon" later in the same sentence.
The editor's "the" is confirmed: the definite article is required before "Great Builder" as a known cosmological title, consistent with the spiritual reading's "the divine formative power."
